requirements.title: Frozen qualification contracts and corpus registry
requirements.invariant: Every R5 gate resolves a pinned candidate, harness, fault schedule, corpus version, oracle version, and expected evidence schema before execution; missing inputs cannot pass.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Canonical manifest validation plus content-hash equality; any missing, extra, mutable, or mismatched required input is FAIL.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Qualification repository and external harness only; no runtime behavior and no R4.1 artifact changes.
requirements.rollback_implications: Harness rollback is allowed only to a separately pinned compatible manifest; evidence from different harness revisions cannot be pooled silently.
requirements.research_relevance: Controls instrumentation drift and supports reproducible comparison without asserting scientific independence.

requirements.title: Evidence governance and counterexample retention
requirements.invariant: Raw observations, failures, indeterminate outcomes, and counterexamples remain append-only, attributable, hash-manifested, and distinct from summaries.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Recompute the evidence graph and SHA-256 manifest; require every declared gate and counterexample, validate provenance, and reject summary/raw disagreement.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Evidence packaging, policy, and verification only; no production protocol mutation.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback must retain evidence created under the newer schema and a reader capable of marking unsupported records indeterminate.
requirements.research_relevance: Prevents later passes from erasing failures and preserves auditability of bounded claims.
exit_criteria: summary is reproducible from raw evidence

requirements.title: Protocol versioning and compatibility negotiation
requirements.invariant: Sender, Station, stored request, and receipt negotiate compatible versions and safety features before mutation; unknown majors and safety-removing downgrades fail closed.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Compare the negotiated transcript with the frozen compatibility table and assert zero mutation or network effect for incompatible pairs.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 wire/storage schemas and negotiation; this plan defines contracts only.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback is blocked when persisted rows require unsupported safety features unless a lossless, qualified downgrade exists.
requirements.research_relevance: Separates protocol effects from version skew and makes longitudinal results interpretable.

requirements.title: Authenticated and request-bound receipts
requirements.invariant: ACKED is reachable only with a verified receipt binding issuer, trust epoch, protocol version, project, operation ID, request digest, event identity, sequence, and outcome.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Verify canonical bytes and trust epoch, compare every bound field to the pending row, and require state to remain non-ACKED on any mismatch.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 receipt issuance and verification; keys and signing mechanisms are selected during implementation review.
requirements.rollback_implications: Do not roll back to a reader that can ACK newer receipts without preserving all mandatory bindings.
requirements.research_relevance: Tests whether receipt authority, rather than transport authentication alone, supports the local ACK claim.

requirements.title: Malformed and cross-bound receipt handling
requirements.invariant: Receipt acceptance is atomic; malformed, oversized, ambiguous, corrupted, or cross-bound input causes no ACK, deletion, send, or partial trusted state.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Parse under frozen limits, validate schema and binding, emit one stable reason code, and compare pre/post state plus network trace for zero unsafe mutation.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 parser/validator and quarantine interface; no parser implementation in this planning change.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback must continue rejecting every receipt form rejected by the active mandatory safety profile.
requirements.research_relevance: Measures false acceptance at the receipt-to-ACK seam.

requirements.title: Explicit durable reconciliation state machine
requirements.invariant: Every operation follows a versioned durable transition graph with explicit INDETERMINATE and RECONCILING states; ambiguity is never represented as success or an automatic resend instruction.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Replay the transition journal through the frozen state graph and compare state/network ordering; any undeclared edge, lost ambiguity, or send from an ineligible state is FAIL.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 outbox schema and transition engine; excludes leases, receipt cryptography, and telemetry implementations.
requirements.rollback_implications: Older binaries must reject unknown states; migrations must be reversible without collapsing INDETERMINATE into PENDING or ACKED.
requirements.research_relevance: Makes ambiguous outcomes directly measurable instead of inferring them from a two-state row.
exit_criteria: graph is acyclic where required and transition-complete

requirements.title: Concurrent recovery ownership and fencing
requirements.invariant: At most one live authority may advance an operation, and every send or ACK transition is conditional on the current monotonically increasing fencing token.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Order lease and mutation records by authority epoch; only the maximum valid token may precede a send or state change, and stale-token attempts must have zero effect.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 ownership subsystem and conditional transitions; topology distribution is R5-SC-009.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback must drain leases or advance the authority epoch; unfenced legacy recovery must never run beside fenced recovery.
requirements.research_relevance: Tests whether recovery remains safe when the single-owner assumption is removed.

requirements.title: Supported topology and multi-host recovery contract
requirements.invariant: Every supported topology uses a qualified lease authority with fencing; unsupported multi-process, shared-filesystem, or multi-host arrangements fail closed before send.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Compare declared topology capabilities, lease authority history, and node traces; require fenced single advancement or pre-send unsupported-topology rejection.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future deployment contract and distributed lease adapter; does not imply SQLite on network filesystems is supported.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback may narrow supported topologies only after quiescence and must reject retained distributed leases it cannot interpret.
requirements.research_relevance: Defines the external-validity boundary for concurrency evidence.
exit_criteria: partition cannot create two advancing owners

requirements.title: Crash-safe local ACK persistence
requirements.invariant: A crash during ACK persistence leaves either the prior reconcilable state or one fully durable verified ACK, never a torn, false, or stale-owner ACK.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: After restart run integrity checks and receipt re-verification; the row must equal a complete pre-ACK state or a complete verified ACK and must obey the current fence.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 ACK transaction and recovery; uses disposable storage only in qualification.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback reader must preserve verified receipts and explicit ambiguous states; otherwise rollback is blocked.
requirements.research_relevance: Extends lost-ACK recovery to the local durability boundary.

requirements.title: Corrupted outbox quarantine and recoverability
requirements.invariant: Corruption causes no send, ACK, deletion, or silent repair; the smallest provably safe unit is quarantined with forensic bytes preserved.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Run integrity and semantic checks on a copy, compare network trace for zero unsafe actions, and verify quarantine scope and byte-preserving manifest.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 corruption detection/quarantine; no repair-in-place requirement.
requirements.rollback_implications: Quarantine format must be preserved across rollback; older versions may not auto-open quarantined stores.
requirements.research_relevance: Distinguishes crash recovery from data-integrity recovery.

requirements.title: SQLite contention, disk exhaustion, and persistence errors
requirements.invariant: No send begins without durable pre-send state and no ACK is reported without durable receipt; BUSY, FULL, IOERR, read-only, quota, and permission failures are bounded and visible.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Correlate injected storage result with durable snapshots and action trace; forbid unjournaled sends and false success, and require bounded retry/exit behavior.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 SQLite transaction/retry policy and storage error surface; no filesystem changes in this plan.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback retains pending/indeterminate work and must not reinterpret storage-error states as sendable.
requirements.research_relevance: Tests whether durability claims survive realistic local resource contention.

requirements.title: Stale-operation policy and explicit operator disposition
requirements.invariant: Age never implies absence, resend, success, or deletion; stale and indeterminate operations remain queryable until a versioned policy or authenticated operator action resolves them.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Evaluate policy using recorded monotonic/wall clocks and authorization; require no state/network action derived solely from age and a durable reason-coded disposition.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 stale policy and operator API; authentication mechanism must reuse approved authority controls.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback preserves disposition and policy version; unknown dispositions remain indeterminate.
requirements.research_relevance: Prevents timeout heuristics from being mistaken for delivery knowledge.

requirements.title: Reconciliation observability and SLO metrics
requirements.invariant: Every transition produces one correlation-safe observation, and low-cardinality metrics reconcile to durable state without exposing payloads, receipts, credentials, or unbounded labels.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Recompute metrics from the transition journal, compare exact counters, enforce label budgets/redaction rules, and evaluate alert timelines with a frozen clock.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 telemetry contract, exporter, and alerts; payload bodies remain outside observability.
requirements.rollback_implications: Metric schema changes require compatibility aliases or explicit dashboard/alert rollback; journal truth remains authoritative.
requirements.research_relevance: Makes reconciliation latency, contention, and indeterminate duration measurable without changing safety semantics.

requirements.title: Receipt retention, tombstones, and garbage collection
requirements.invariant: GC cannot erase uniqueness evidence while retry is possible; expiry leaves an authenticated tombstone or equivalent proof for the declared replay horizon.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Compare policy horizon, GC journal, tombstone proof, restored-client trace, event count, and storage bound; a second event or missing uniqueness proof is FAIL.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 receipt lifecycle and deletion policy; legal policy approval remains external.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback must preserve tombstones and replay horizon; policy shrink is irreversible only through separately authorized migration.
requirements.research_relevance: Defines the time horizon over which delivery claims remain supportable.

requirements.title: Distributed receipt lookup authority and consistency
requirements.invariant: Lookup distinguishes found, authoritative absence, non-authoritative, and indeterminate; only an authority-backed answer can advance state, and ambiguous absence cannot authorize repost.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Validate authority/consistency metadata against the fault schedule and forbid POST after any non-authoritative or indeterminate absence.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future R5 distributed Station lookup semantics; does not require multi-region support unless declared.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback must reject consistency metadata it cannot validate and remain indeterminate rather than treating it as absence.
requirements.research_relevance: Tests whether reconciliation safety survives moving beyond a single authoritative Station.

requirements.title: Formal external-effect claim boundary
requirements.invariant: The published claim names its effect boundary; downstream effects use a stable effect ID transactionally/idempotently or remain explicitly indeterminate, never labeled exactly-once without evidence.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Model-check the frozen property and compare executable traces through the refinement map; preserve any counterexample and prohibit broader claims than the checked boundary.
requirements.implementation_boundary: Future model and downstream test adapters; does not promise universal exactly-once delivery.
requirements.rollback_implications: Rollback cannot broaden the claim; incompatible downstream consumers force the reported state to indeterminate.
requirements.research_relevance: Separates observed receiver deduplication from end-to-end external-effect claims.

requirements.title: Phased qualification and convergence controller
requirements.invariant: Each phase is independently pinned and qualifiable; final R5 convergence requires every requirement and phase gate PASS with no unresolved, missing, or silently retried evidence.
requirements.deterministic_oracle: Topologically validate the DAG, verify every requirement/phase evidence manifest, and compute disposition fail-closed from immutable gate outcomes.
requirements.implementation_boundary: External R5 qualification orchestration only; no product runtime authority and no self-attestation by the candidate.
requirements.rollback_implications: A phase rollback invalidates downstream qualification until those phases are rerun against the new lineage.
requirements.research_relevance: Enables incremental evidence without treating integration success as proof of all component invariants.

edge_definition: For each requirement, every dependency creates a directed edge dependency -> requirement. The dependencies arrays are the canonical complete edge set.
